summary: Variables can be set on parent groups with the same :vars or vars: syntax, as shown with usa > southeast > atlanta/raleigh, and child group variables override parent ones.
questions: How do I set variables on a group of groups?
Do child group vars override parent group vars?

answer_card.title: Variables on parent groups
answer_card.answer_md:
Same syntax as any group:
```ini
[southeast:children]
atlanta
raleigh

[southeast:vars]
some_server=foo.southeast.example.com
```
A child group's variables override the parent group's.
